items.description:
These magic teen skins are great for roleplay and adventure!
* 22 HD skins!

items.title: Fairy Fun
items.creator: Dark Lab Creations
items.description:
These fairy fun skins are ready for adventure!
* 22 HD skins!

items.title: Anime Pet Party
items.creator: Dark Lab Creations
items.description:
These animals are ready to party and hang out!
* 22 HD skins!

items.title: Heroic Anime
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
School is finally out, the sun is high in the sky, and the signs and sounds of summer vacation is finally here! Feel the beat of the nightlife and enjoy your time among these heroic teens. Feel the need for speed and become the hero of the story. Be careful on the many unexptected adventures!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Mobs of the Month - July
items.creator: House of How
items.description: 12 basketball stars are slam dunking their way through July. A skin pack of extreme mob athletes, join the "A" team today and get ready to show the globe your skills!

items.title: ROLEPLAY
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
ROLEPLAY is great for anyone who loves to roleplay in any world.

*Includes 10 skins that are fun to use

items.title: Advanced World in a Jar
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Experience the classic extreme survival map called world in a jar, but with a modern look and more unique bottled biomes! Find the hidden treasures scattered throughout the dark and dangerous lands and unlock the portal to the end and bring the battle to the ender dragon!

- A lot of cool bottled biomes
- Hidden secrets
- hours of survival gameplay
- By inPixel

items.title: More Animals
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Enhance your survival experience with More Animals! Find new animals in all biomes! Zebras, Tigers, Lions, Elephants, Frogs, Ducks, Monkeys, Penguins, Sharks, and many more! With over 40 new species, there’s a lot for you to explore!

+ 40+ new species added!
+ Mutliplayer & Singeplayer friendly
+ Can be played in both survival and creative!

items.title: Music Concert
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Ever wanted to control the efffects at a music concert? The lasers, smoke machines and lights are all under your control! Ever wanted to conduct a classical music concert? Ever visited a jazz bar? Well now is the chance for you to do all of these! 

+ Jazz bar
+ Pop concert
+ Rock concert
+ Classical concert
+ Custom music!

items.title: Purple Rush Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Feel the excitement, feel the rush! Enjoy this collection of trendy teens expressing themselves with various forms of purple fashion. Featuring accessories such as a funky purple mushroom hat, cute bunny mask, horns, and more!

+ 12 skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Desert City
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Welcome to Desert City! Roleplay the hot sunny days or choose one of the city homes!

+ Detailed desert city!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Millionaire Aloha Vacation
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Live in a tropical aloha city! Take a vacation on a million-dollar yacht to the tropics!

+ Hawaiian city home!
+ Million dollar yacht!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: The Lazy Bunker
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Out in the midst of the forest, you've mysteriously stumbled upon a cozy and quaint, little tavern. What is it doing around here? Want to find out?

+ Big survival spawn map!
+ Many secret rooms!
+ Make the place your own!

items.title: Lucky Skyblock Modern Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
What's better than your own private mansion? How about a millionaire mansion in the sky! Welcome to a new life of luxury, luck and fun!

- 10 lucky blocks!
- Over 100 lucky or unlucky events!
- Custom massive skyblock spawn!

items.title: Derpy Candy
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Who doesn't love candy? With cookies and chocolate bars and jelly beans, this pack is perfect for anyone with a sweet tooth!

+ 7 funny candy skins
+ Super sweet designs

items.title: Planes
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Become a pilot and unlock hangars to fly with 9 customizable planes. Explore the big airport and the city in the custom terrain.

+ 9 customizable planes & 1 helicopter
+ 4 ground vehicles
+ 1 city location
+ Licensed by Levelatics and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Weapons Extension Pack!
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
See which crafting recipe you need, collect all the required items and craft new weapons in this weapons expansion! We have everything you need, magic abilities, new bows, swords and crossbows with unique spells, spears and much more equipment!

+Craftable!
+Arena perfect for PVP & PVE!
+All weapons have unique abilities!
+Lightning Hammer, Explosive Bow, Ice Sword, etc.

items.title: Retro Teens
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Want to dress like the '80s babies? Here’s a pack sure to help you live out your big hair and baggy clothes dream! Step foot into the rockstar world of retro teenage life with this skin pack!

+ Includes 7 awesome skins

items.title: Kings in Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
These ender kings and queens are showing off some neon style! Choose from an array of colors and personalities to represent your darker, more royal self! Will your subjects be lucky and ruled by a just monarch?

- Includes 10 neon ender king and queen skins!
- Build your modern Minecraft kingdom and show off your style!

items.title: Skyblock Secret Base
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
What's better than having a luxurious modern mansion on a skyblock island? Having a giant underground secret base below the mansion of course! Thrive and survive in this unique skyblock island with your friends and discover what lies deep below!

+ Giant modern mansion
+ Skyblock island stocked with ore 
+ Completely functional secret base
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Parkour Tower
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Parkour is a minigame where you must complete jumps to win! Use parkour skills and scale the tower! Regardless of your skill level, this map is great to master your parkour skillset.

items.title: Nekotron Texture Pack
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Prepare for some amazing futuristic blocks! Being creative has never been this easy! From space stations to colorful city buildings you will be sure to impress all your Minecraft friends with this awesome texture pack!
* Fully loaded with awesome choices for diverse build styles!
* Skins included!
* Perfect for creative mode & survival!

items.title: Crazy Anime Buddies
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Join in on wacky adventures and amazing fun with your kooky best pals with these amazingly cool and cute-looking Japanese cartoon-inspired outfits!

- 12 anime skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Zombie Knights
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Become a fighter from beyond the grave! Undead sword wielding fun awaits you! Spook your friends with your rotting-cool look and defeat your enemies!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot
